description: Nordic Semiconductor NRF52840-QIAA-R — 2.4 GHz Bluetooth LE SoC in a 73-contact 7.0 × 7.0 mm AQFN with a 4.85 mm exposed pad.
name: nrf52840-qiaa-r

provenance.source: EasyEDA import from LCSC C190794; complete symbol-to-footprint contact set, exposed pad, antenna, SWD, reset, USB, supply, and ground contacts reviewed from the imported package data.

watch_out_for: Pad 0 is the exposed pad; do not treat it as an ordinary signal pin. The RF ANT contact is H23 and requires the Nordic-recommended matching network, antenna keep-out, and RF layout. The vendored MPN is NRF52840-QIAA-R; NRF52840-QIAA-R7 is the reel order code and shares this package.
